name: Ramsons Projects Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Ramsons Projects Ltd is engaged in lending and investment activities.
keyPoints:
Registration:[1]
Company holds Certificate of Registration
(COR) from Reserve Bank of India to act as a Non-Banking Financial Institution, without accepting public deposits.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 44.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 123 days to 81.9 days
cons: Stock is trading at 4.18 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.60% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.94 Cr.
